candidates.title: Will Carlos Alcaraz win at least 2.5 more games than Alexander Zverev?
candidates.rules_primary: If the game differential in favor of Carlos Alcaraz across the full match is above 2.5 games in the Alexander Zverev vs Carlos Alcaraz professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP World Tour Finals Men Singles Final, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to the Alexander Zverev vs Carlos Alcaraz professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP World Tour Finals Men Singles Final. If the match does not occur (signaled by a ball being played) due to a player injury, walkover, forfeiture, or any other cancellation (all before the match starts), the market will resolve to a fair price in accordance with the rules. If this match is postponed or delayed, the market will remain open and close after the rescheduled match has finished (within two weeks). If a retirement occurs, all markets that can be unconditionally settled based on play already completed will resolve accordingly.
